summary: Context.dev's free tier includes 1,000 API credits per month (a standard scrape starts at 1 credit; extraction/brand calls cost more) plus a separate one-time 10K Logo Link quota — no credit card required. The Free plan allows 2 concurrent core API requests per organization, with no per-minute cap by default. Organizations created before concurrency limits keep per-key per-minute limits (Free: 10 personal email, 30 work email); custom overrides may apply. Check the dashboard.
claim_steps: Sign up at context.dev/signup — no credit card required.
1,000 API credits renew monthly; the separate 10K Logo Link quota is one-time.

The Free plan allows 2 concurrent core API requests per organization, with no per-minute cap by default. Organizations created before concurrency limits keep per-key per-minute limits (Free: 10 personal email, 30 work email); custom overrides may apply. Check the dashboard.

social_proof.title: Context.dev pricing FAQ (checked 2026-10-26)
social_proof.text: Core API limits cap concurrent requests per organization: Free allows 2; Developer 10, Pro 100, Growth 250, and Scale 500. Plans have no per-minute cap by default. Existing accounts keep their current allowances until they change plans; custom overrides can apply to either limit or both. The dashboard shows your effective limits.

social_proof.title: Context.dev Plans and billing docs (checked 2026-10-26)
social_proof.text: Organizations created before concurrency limits keep per-minute limits per API key on every plan: 30 on Free with a work email, 10 on Free with a personal email, 60 on Developer, 200 on Pro, 600 on Growth, and 700 on Scale.
